scope: Only local API2 sources/manuals and explicit user confirmation. No robot motion, configuration or algorithm calls.

frame_ids.binding: Connection records bind logical left to verified controller .19; handle IDs are process-local. Definitions are also fingerprinted; same name with changed offsets is not accepted against old workspace evidence.

work.semantics: Active work frame pose is relative to controller base.
sources: Local Python manual PDF p60 §5.8.2 and p62 §5.9.1

tool.semantics: Active tool endpoint pose is relative to flange center. This does not verify physical grasp TCP or full gripper geometry.
sources: Local Python manual PDF p56 §5.6.6 and p58 §5.7.1

ee_pose_binding.reason: Local current-state function/struct/manual only says current pose; it does not explicitly identify reference and target frames.
ee_pose_binding.inference_only: TubePickingSimulation demo uses current pose then a work-axis movel offset, but without nondefault work/tool this does not prove the state contract.

workspace.evidence: User offered 我可以手动先示教一遍; no recorded demonstration or collision-free volume provided.
workspace.note: A demonstrated curve or observed EE pose does not certify a surrounding AABB. Record work/tool definitions and then obtain explicit human-confirmed tool-swept clearance bounds; never derive them from the 2 mm step limit.

camera.consequence: Grounding warning, not unconditional rejection of an explicitly robot-work-frame delta. A future explicit camera transform requires verified extrinsics.

full_gripper_geometry.local_phase_exception: Only fixed-orientation local free-space translation with human-certified swept-tool clearance, not a grasp approach.
